page.overview:
Who is Flying Rooster?

The is initially a deceased corpse resting underneath the of . By playing the "" next to him, can resurrect him. The will then follow around on the . By holding him above his head, is able to fly, allowing him to reach the in . The can also be used to an optional near the bridge of .

Once has completed , the will leave and make his new home in the with the . The is seen giving the man some flights in his house, and will no longer be able to use it.
